identity_gate: CTD chemical ID and name plus a mapped NHANES analyte
exposure_interpretability_gate: mapped analyte with high, moderate, or low prespecified mapping confidence
nhanes_availability_gate: analyte variable present in downloaded catalog/XPT registry
survey_design_gate: NHANES laboratory weight and participant identifier present; cycle-level NHANES design files are available for downstream use
actionable_rule: identity_gate=1 AND exposure_interpretability_gate=1 AND nhanes_availability_gate=1 AND detectability_D>=1 AND cycle_coverage_C>=1 AND survey_design_gate=1
